customer_message.subject: Defects in rented flat Mattenweg 41 - mould, damp and heating failure
customer_message.body:
Dear Legal Expenses Team,

I am writing to request support regarding a defect in my rented flat at Mattenweg 41, Bern, a 3-room flat. The landlord is Immobilien Seeblick AG.

There is mould growth and persistent damp patches in the children's room. I have reported this to the landlord, but the problem has not been resolved.

In addition, the heating does not work properly. Rooms stay cold and several radiators fail, so that the flat cools down to about 16 degrees. This has continued for some time despite my requests for repair.

The landlord has not fixed either problem. I intend to pay the rent into the official rent deposit (Hinterlegung) if the defect is not fixed within a reasonable period. Before I take that step, I would like to know how your insurance can support me in this matter and what documents you need from me.

I can provide copies of my correspondence with the landlord and photographs of the affected rooms on request. Please let me know the next steps and whether a legal consultation can be arranged.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Riley Bennett
